Original Decipher card face for [[Gall]], rotated 180° from the archive scan [[:File:DS2-D-gall-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's Dark Side card list scan shows this card Light Side up; this copy turns it so the Dark Side text reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no crop, no rescaling.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/gall.gif gall.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010907084842/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/gall.gif Internet Archive], 7 September 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: e7881c21f25c36ed46bd86ceedce3d380dffa5cecf681fd4445cf50a1e1b0194.

The PC Holotable face is [[:File:DS2-D-gall.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
